test_browser_use_local_mode: test the browser tool stays in local mode when cloud_provider is set to local even with managed gateway available
test_browserbase_not_configured: test the browserbase provider returns not configured when only gateway URL is set without API keys
test_browser_use_create_session: test the BrowserUseProvider creates a session with idempotency key and persists external call id from gateway response
test_browser_use_reuses_idempotency_key: test the BrowserUseProvider reuses the same idempotency key after a timeout to avoid duplicate session creation
test_terminal_modal_managed_fallback: test the terminal tool prefers managed modal environment in auto mode and falls back to direct modal when managed is unavailable
